Replaces Hunting Grounds. At battle start Homm3FortressPredatorInstinctRuntime pairs each melee stack (ranged too with Endurance Hunting) of a Fortress hero 1-to-1 with a random enemy stack; predators deal +33/66/100% damage to their prey and, while the prey lives, 17/33/50% less damage to other targets (counter hits included) inside the single committed-damage owner, and hovering a Fortress stack draws a blood-red line to its prey.
